data.name: Nibras
data.gender_notes: Nibras is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nibras is a diminutive form of nibr, which refers to a small drop of water. It symbolizes purity and innocence. The name Nibras carries the meaning “Little drop” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nibras usually hope their child will grow to embody little drop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nibras is associated with the concept of humility and the reminder of God's mercy.
data.etymology: Nibras belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little drop.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nibras total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نبراس
in_arabic.meaning: نبراس هو اسم يعني مصباح أو نور مضيء في الظلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: نبراس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني المصباح أو النور المضيء في الظلام، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور آية 35 'وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ * يَهْدِي مِثْلَ هَذَا لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ * فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ * رِجَالٌ لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ * لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّنْ فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ'

in_urdu.name: نبراس
in_urdu.meaning: نبراس کا مطلب ہے روشنی کا ایک ذریعہ یا اندھیرے میں ایک روشن چراغ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نبراس ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی کا ایک ذریعہ یا اندھیرے میں ایک روشن چراغ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة النور میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ نبراس نام ذہانت، روشن خیالی اور روحانی رہنمائی کی خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: निब्रास
in_hindi.meaning: निब्रास का अर्थ है एक प्रकाश का स्रोत या अंधेरे में एक चमकता हुआ दीपक
in_hindi.long_meaning: निब्रास एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है एक प्रकाश का स्रोत या अंधेरे में एक चमकता हुआ दीपक। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत अन-नूर में आया है। निब्रास नाम बुद्धिमत्ता, ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शन की विशेषताओं को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: نبراس
in_pashto.meaning: نبراس د رڼا یو سرچینه یا په تیروالي کې یو روښانه څراغ
in_pashto.long_meaning: نبراس یو عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې د رڼا یو سرچینه یا په تیروالي کې یو روښانه څراغ دی. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې د سورت النور په 35 آیت کې راغلی دی. نبراس نوم د پوهې، حکمت او روحاني لارښوونې ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Nibras
in_english.meaning: Nibras means a source of light or a shining lamp in darkness
in_english.long_meaning: Nibras is an Arabic name that means a source of light or a shining lamp in darkness. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah An-Nur, verse 35. The name Nibras signifies intelligence, enlightenment, and spiritual guidance. It is associated with qualities such as wisdom, knowledge, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nibras holds deep cultural significance for many Muslims around the world. It is a name that is commonly found in the Arab world and persian speaking countries, and it is associated with the ideals of purity and innocence. In many cultures, water is seen as a symbol of life, and the word "nibr" being derived from it, represents the idea of new beginnings and innocence, often given to babies and young children.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nibras holds great significance as it reflects the Muslim belief in the concept of "Fitrah" or the "original nature". The name Nibras signifies the purity that is within every human being which is untouched by worldly influences and desires. This purity is something that Muslims are encouraged to strive to maintain throughout their lives in order to live in accordance with the teachings of Islam. The name also carries a spiritual reminder of the importance of maintaining innocence and purity of heart, as stated in the Quran: "And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds" (21:107).
